# Standalone Asio

- Version: 1.30.2 (`ASIO_VERSION 103002`)
- Source: https://github.com/chriskohlhoff/asio/releases/tag/asio-1-30-2
- License: Boost Software License 1.0 (see LICENSE_1_0.txt / COPYING)
- Usage: header-only, include `asio.hpp` with `ASIO_STANDALONE` defined.

Only the `include/` tree is vendored; examples/tests/build scripts are not.
